skills.name: data-analysis
skills.description: Explore, clean, and summarize tabular data. Use when asked to analyze a CSV, spreadsheet, or dataset.

skills.name: declank
skills.description: Rewrite text, code comments, or documentation to be shorter, plainer, and more direct. Use when asked to tighten, simplify, shorten, or de-fluff writing, or to clean up verbose comments or docs.

skills.name: docx-handling
skills.description: Create, read, and edit Word (.docx) documents. Use when a task involves a .docx file as input or output.

skills.name: huh
skills.description: Re-explain your last response in simpler, plainer words. Use when the user says "huh?", "I don't follow", "simpler please", or that an answer was too complicated.

skills.name: second-opinion
skills.description: Review a diff or pull request for correctness, readability, and maintainability issues. Use when asked to review code changes.
